help.port: Opens a dedicated HTTP(S) proxy inbound; can run alongside the mixed port with no conflict.
help.socks-port: Opens a dedicated SOCKS5 proxy inbound; can run alongside the mixed port with no conflict.
help.mixed-port: Serves both HTTP(S) and SOCKS5 on the same port — typically used instead of the two dedicated ports above.
help.tun.enable: Once enabled, Mihomo creates a virtual network adapter and takes over system traffic, so individual apps don't need their own proxy setup; this is a system-level networking change.
help.tun.dns-hijack: DNS requests matching these addresses are redirected to Mihomo's own built-in DNS server.
help.tun.auto-redirect: Automatically configures iptables to redirect TCP connections into TUN, reducing manual routing setup; Linux only, and it modifies the system firewall rules.
